correctness.rationale: Exact self-contained standard-library verifier enumerates 36 perfect matchings, all 30,503 nonempty simplices and 163,650 Hasse arrows; full topological sort validates 15,231 matched pairs and critical counts one 0-cell, ten 2-cells and thirty 3-cells. The integral Morse boundary B has 9-dimensional mod-two image, a determinant-two full 10-minor and determinant-minus-one 9-minor; these force Smith form nine ones and two. Since the reduced CW complex has no 1-cells, its two-skeleton is a wedge of 2-spheres, so Smith diagonalization of the 3-cell degree vectors yields M(Z/2,2) wedge twenty S3. All computations were independently replayed from the intended standalone verifier path.

value.rationale: The natural perfect-matching complex of the classical 20-vertex dodecahedral fullerene is a mathematically motivated topological refinement of the historically studied 36 Kekulé structures. Its exact homotopy type detects genuine integral order-two torsion, which matching-count tables, ordinary matching-complex results and characteristic-zero topology do not determine. This is a complete natural small-case classification with nontrivial homotopical structure, not a routine numerical increment.
